value.rationale: Exact vertex mobility in a constrained interconnection/state network is a natural invariant of robustness, distinct from global edge counts. The four-periodic sharp minimum and uniqueness of the worst-case state at n divisible by four provide a structural network phenomenon, and the constant-size transfer resolves all degree frequencies at every blocklength.
